title: Updated: Beauty’s biggest brand closures and administration troubles in 2026 so far
summary: SF: The tough economic challenges from last year have bled into 2026, as Scarlett Johansson’s skin care brand The Outset join beauty businesses Malin + Goetz, CoverFX, Mally Beauty and Gwen Stefani’s GXVE, which have either closed or been placed into administration

extraction.key_fact: 경제적 어려움이 이어지면서 여러 뷰티 브랜드들이 폐업하거나 법정관리에 들어갔다.
